(a) For commuter category aeroplanes, an evacuation demonstration must be conducted utilising the maximum number of occupants for which certification is desired. The demonstration must be conducted under simulated night conditions using only the emergency exits on the most critical side of the aeroplane. The participants must be representative of average airline passengers with no prior practice or rehearsal for the demonstration. Evacuation must be completed within 90 seconds .
(b) In addition, when certification to the emergency exit provisions of CS 23.807(d)(4) is requested, only the emergency lighting system required by CS 23.812 may be used to provide cabin interior illumination during the evacuation demonstration required in sub-paragraph (a) .
